code: (async()=>{const E=window.__echoes;const raf=()=>new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r));const spawn8=()=>{const P=[[-5,-6.6],[5,-6.6],[-10.2,-3],[10.2,-3],[-10.2,3],[10.2,3],[-5,6.6],[5,6.6]];P.forEach((p,i)=>E.cmd("spawn",i%3===1?"mantis":"boar",p[0],p[1]));};const phase=async(on,ms)=>{E.hud.setEnabled(on);await raf();await raf();const d=[];let last=performance.now();const t0=last;while(performance.now()-t0<ms){await raf();const n=performance.now();d.push(n-last);last=n;}d.sort((a,b)=>a-b);return {n:d.length,med:+d[Math.floor(d.length/2)].toFixed(2),p90:+d[Math.floor(d.length*0.9)].toFixed(2)};};const cyc=[];const onAll=[],offAll=[];for(let c=0;c<6;c++){if(c%2===0){E.cmd("teleport",0,0);spawn8();}const mk=E.hud.markers().length;const en=(E.state().enemies||[]).length;const a=await phase(true,700);const b=await phase(false,700);cyc.push({c,enemies:en,markers:mk,on:a,off:b});onAll.push(a.med);offAll.push(b.med);}E.hud.setEnabled(true);const med=(x)=>{const s=[...x].sort((a,b)=>a-b);return s[Math.floor(s.length/2)];};const mo=med(onAll),mf=med(offAll);return {cycles:cyc,onMedianMs:mo,offMedianMs:mf,onFps:+(1000/mo).toFixed(1),offFps:+(1000/mf).toFixed(1),costMs:+(mo-mf).toFixed(2),costPct:+((mo-mf)/mf*100).toFixed(1),markersNow:E.hud.markers().length,fpsMeter:E.fps};})()
